Accepted cancellation could leave provider dirty bytes replayable after server effects. validate_reply now poisons accepted failures while preserving initial errno; subsequent Read/Write/Seek issue no RPC, Close remains usable, and undelivered cancellation remains retryable.
resolved_defects.proof: Pinned provider dirty-offset/flush source and core accepted-cancellation paths inspected; independent 30-case O0/O2 ASan+UBSan harness passed; removing only poisoning makes the subsequent-write regression abort.

details: Descriptor slots reserved before remote Open; doubling growth failure preserves prior table.

Old operation pins retain File and mapping slot after numerical descriptor reuse.
Final release checks slot pointer identity before clearing it; table remains until final record/pin retires.
No capacity arithmetic overflow under the specified LP64 int descriptor bound.
Final-reference unlink remains a cold linked-list scan; whole Close is not claimed O(1).
